donitz_monk_robe.author: Donitz
donitz_monk_robe.description: A classic medieval monk's robe with optional hoods. This is my first contribution to the MakeHuman community. I've used MH for years but never tried making clothes for it before so designing this robe for a game I'm making was a great opportunity to learn. There are a few different color variations for the robe at http://www.makehumancommunity.org/forum/viewtopic.php?f=4&t=20802

donitz_monk_robe_hood.author: Donitz
donitz_monk_robe_hood.description: A classic medieval monk's robe's hood. It was created for the 'Monk's robe' in Gown/Robe.

donitz_monk_robe_hood_down.author: Donitz
donitz_monk_robe_hood_down.description: A classic medieval monk's robe's hood covering the eyes. It was created for the 'Monk's robe' in Gown/Robe.

donitz_monk_robe_hood_off.author: Donitz
donitz_monk_robe_hood_off.description: A classic medieval monk's robe's hood when it's off. It was created for the 'Monk's robe' in Gown/Robe.

green_tomato_yoko_tsuno.description: A space suit inspired by the comicbook of the same name.

joachip_cyborg_suit.author: joachip
joachip_cyborg_suit.description: A strange robotic kind of protective gear that fits any steam punk environment. Select 'none' for hair or it's gonna protrude out of the helmet and look silly. You will need to go to the 'custom asset' section and get 'Weights file for Cyborg Suit' and then put the files 'Cyborg_suit.mhw' in your clothes/Cyborg_suit folder.

matcreator_mc-bodysuit-2021.author: MatCreator
matcreator_mc-bodysuit-2021.description: Many thanks to the community for the help thus far = This is a 'derivative' of the tights helper geometry that will be the base for future releases. Enjoy =

matcreator_mc-scifi-armor_guardian.author: MatCreator
matcreator_mc-scifi-armor_guardian.description: Armor layer for the MC-BodySuit-2021. Boots and bracers. Apply over the bodysuit look for future releases.

matcreator_mc-scifi-armor_jupiter7.author: MatCreator
matcreator_mc-scifi-armor_jupiter7.description: Armor layer for the MC-BodySuit-2021. Boots chest pelvic arm and leg plating. Apply over the bodysuit look for future releases.

matcreator_mc-skinsuit_2022.author: MatCreator
matcreator_mc-skinsuit_2022.description: Another derivative but lower poly count makes it universal to fit all body types w/ minimal distortion. Texture sets and add-on layers coming soon = Combine with existing secondary layer sets for more options and versatility.

thegreatengineer_galactic_warrior_unifor.author: TheGreatEngineer
thegreatengineer_galactic_warrior_unifor.description: This is a uniform I made for one of my characters for a story I'm creating. It's my first upload so don't judge too harshly. Strangely with my Character there seems to be a very slight issue with the weighting as you can see below but for any character scaled reasonably it should work fine. Also this piece is intended for female characters. It's a sci-fi fantasy uniform meant to be worn by soldiers on the battlefield.
